title: Payment Gateway Timeout & Cascading Latency
summary: External payment provider API latency caused thread pool starvation in payment service workers.
symptoms: Payment checkout timed out after 30 seconds for 42% of users
Upstream cart service failing with HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout
root_cause: Missing HTTP client request timeout on third-party payment gateway integration causing worker threads to hang indefinitely.
resolution: Configured 3-second HTTP client socket timeout with circuit breaker pattern using Resilience4j.
